Why the spec was not reachable: AK-3 is 50% volume solids, and the gun only transfers about 18% onto the panel (checked on the card and on a non-sagging patch; standoff 100–180 mm and speed 100–400 mm/s did not change that). At that efficiency the full 320 ml pot can average only about 48 µm across three 450×450 mm lids, which is under the 55 µm minimum even with perfect distribution. Flow above 200 ml/min, or a heavy wet build in one pass, flags runs. A safe coat is on the order of 20 µm DFT, so the spec needs several flashed coats and more paint than is on site.

Next time: more AK-3 (or a higher-transfer gun) before unattended topcoat, and no production spray until a full-panel trial hits 55–85 µm with no runs.
